profile.headline: IT Support Specialist & Aspiring Network Engineer
profile.bio: Dedicated IT professional with solid foundations in networking, desktop systems, and troubleshooting. Passionate about maintaining secure and reliable infrastructure.

experience.title: Junior Desktop Support Technician
experience.description: Provide daily Tier 1-2 desktop support, configure workstation images, manage user accounts in Active Directory, and resolve network connectivity issues.

jobs.title: Senior Desktop Support Specialist
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Desktop Support Specialist to provide technical assistance, hardware deployment, and OS troubleshooting across our enterprise infrastructure.
responsibilities: Manage enterprise hardware deployment, imaging, and workstation lifecycle
Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 desktop support for Windows 11, macOS, and Linux systems
Administer Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD, and Office 365 environments
Diagnose printer, peripheral, and local network connectivity issues
requirements: 3+ years in enterprise desktop or technical support
Proficiency with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy
Experience with ServiceNow or Jira ticketing tools
CompTIA A+ or Network+ certification preferred

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist (Tier 2)
jobs.description: Join our frontline customer IT team delivering exceptional technical support, endpoint management, and troubleshooting for enterprise healthcare clients.
responsibilities: Resolve end-user technical inquiries via ticketing, phone, and remote assistance
Install and configure network printers, VoIP phones, and desktop peripherals
Maintain software licenses and equipment inventories
requirements: 1+ years technical support or help desk experience
Demonstrated diagnostic skills in Windows and basic Linux environments
Outstanding customer-facing verbal and written communication

jobs.title: Network Engineer (CCNA / Routing & Switching)
jobs.description: Looking for a skilled Network Engineer to architect, maintain, and secure complex multi-site enterprise networks utilizing Cisco routers, switches, and firewalls.
responsibilities: Design, configure, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst switches, ISR routers, and ASA firewalls
Manage routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across redundant topologies
Monitor network bandwidth, latency, and packet loss using Wireshark and SolarWinds
Maintain site-to-site IPsec VPN tunnels and client SSL VPN connections
requirements: Active CCNA certification required (CCNP is a plus)
Hands-on expertise with TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, and subnetting
Proficiency in Linux network configuration and command line utilities

jobs.title: Junior Network Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Great opportunity for aspiring networking professionals to join a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) monitoring edge infrastructure and routing anomalies.
responsibilities: Monitor real-time network alerts, packet drops, and carrier link outages
Triage routing issues using traceroute, ping, and DNS query analysis
Coordinate with telecommunications carriers for circuit diagnostics and dispatch
requirements: Understanding of OSI 7-layer model, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP fundamentals
Exposure to Linux environments and terminal networking commands
CCNA study or certification in progress

jobs.title: SOC Security Analyst (Tier 1 / Incident Response)
jobs.description: Join our Security Operations Center to detect, analyze, and mitigate cyber security threats, malware infections, and suspicious network activity.
responsibilities: Monitor SIEM alerts (Splunk / Sentinel) and triage security telemetry
Investigate phishing submissions, malware payloads, and endpoint detections
Perform initial containment actions and write incident escalation reports
requirements: Familiarity with network protocols, packet inspection, and attack vectors
CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or CEH certification
Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and Linux security logs

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Lead vulnerability assessments, cloud perimeter defense, and zero-trust policy enforcement across hybrid enterprise networks.
responsibilities: Deploy and tune next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet)
Conduct regular vulnerability scanning and penetration test simulations
Implement Identity & Access Management (IAM) and multi-factor security policies
requirements: 3+ years practical cyber security engineering experience
Solid command of Linux internals, script automation (Python/Bash)
CISSP or CEH credential

jobs.title: Full-Stack JavaScript / React Engineer
jobs.description: Build modern, responsive, high-scale web applications using React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and RESTful microservices.
responsibilities: Develop modular and reusable React components with clean state management
Build scalable backend REST APIs in Node.js and Express
Optimize database queries and ensure high Lighthouse performance benchmarks
requirements: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React, and Node.js
Experience with modern styling tools such as Tailwind CSS
Familiarity with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Developer (React & UI/UX)
jobs.description: Exciting entry role for creative developers eager to craft fluid web interfaces and interactive client dashboards.
responsibilities: Translate Figma design mockups into pixel-perfect responsive HTML/CSS/React code
Consume backend REST APIs and implement intuitive form validations
Collaborate with product designers on accessibility (a11y) standards
requirements: Solid command of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React
Passion for clean design and mobile-first responsiveness
Portfolio or GitHub repositories demonstrating frontend projects

jobs.title: Backend API Engineer (Python & FastAPI)
jobs.description: Architect resilient data streaming services and high-throughput RESTful endpoints using Python, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
responsibilities: Build asynchronous API microservices with Python and FastAPI
Integrate machine learning inference pipelines and OpenAI models
Implement Redis caching and database indexing optimizations
requirements: 2+ years Python backend development
Knowledge of SQL, Docker, and API security (JWT / OAuth2)

jobs.title: Data Analyst (SQL, Python & Power BI)
jobs.description: Transform complex business datasets into intuitive dashboards, predictive indicators, and executive summaries.
responsibilities: Write complex SQL queries, window functions, and views across relational warehouses
Design interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards for cross-departmental stakeholders
Perform exploratory data analysis using Python (Pandas, NumPy)
requirements: Strong command of SQL data aggregation and schema design
Proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Excel Pivot)
Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related experience

jobs.title: Cloud Support & Infrastructure Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description: Provide operational support, infrastructure automation, and container orchestration across Amazon Web Services environments.
responsibilities: Maintain AWS EC2 instances, VPC peering, Route 53, and S3 storage policies
Support Docker container builds and CI/CD pipelines
Diagnose Linux server performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and disk I/O
requirements: 2+ years supporting cloud workloads on AWS or Azure
Strong Linux shell scripting (Bash/Python)
AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Cloud Practitioner
